messages:
alex: Heads-up — PR #11720 (optimize request batching) is ready but CI is flaking on integration tests. Want to land before the team freeze at 18:00 UTC; can we get a manual rerun or a merge-throttle slot?

tara: @alex can you paste failing job id? I can request a rerun from release bot.

alex: workflow id: abcdef-1234. Failing job: integration_tests (job 45). Error: "DB connection timed out after 30s". Snippet:
```
E   TimeoutError: Failed to connect to test-db within 30s
.../tests/test_user_cache.py:87
```

liam: we've been seeing db timeouts in us-west during big CI storms. SRE said they'd throttle non-critical runs.

sre-bot: ci-queue-length: 22; ci-backpressure: true; suggested action: manual-rerun-limited

tara: plan: (1) request manual rerun now, (2) if rerun fails twice, hold merge until after freeze and queue for rescheduled merge slot tomorrow morning. @julia can you pre-approve if green? We'll also set merge-throttle to prevent accidental drops.

julia: happy to pre-approve pending green CI. ping me when rerun finishes.

alex: requested rerun: `release-bot rerun workflow abcdef-1234 --jobs integration_tests` — kicked off.

sre-bot: rerun started (job 45) — estimated finish ~5m.

tara: tagging @eng-oncall in case backpressure persists: @eng-oncall please watch ci capacity for next 30m.

liam: if rerun flakes again, short-term workaround: split the failing test into a separate job and mark as flaky to speed merge. Longer-term: look at test DB pool sizing.

alex: noted. I'll try splitting locally if we need to. Thanks all.

julia: will review once green. :thumbsup:

tara: closing loop — I'll update the release tracker depending on outcome.
